content: {"argument": "The behavior change was intentional as indicated by the PR title 'Refactor URL normalization edge handling'. The modification changed the condition from checking if keepQueryParameters length > 0 to > 1, meaning arrays with zero or one elements are now treated as falsy for keeping query parameters. For a single-element array, the function skips the filtering loop entirely, allowing all query parameters to remain instead of filtering to keep only the specified one. This aligns with treating empty or single-item keep lists as 'no keep filter', which may be the intended refactor behavior.", "concedes": false}
